title: Glowing present with a bow
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='boxG' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5a7a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c81e4a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ribG' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb300'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- box body -->
  <rect x='18' y='48' width='64' height='42' rx='4' fill='url(#boxG)'/>
  <!-- lid -->
  <rect x='14' y='38' width='72' height='14' rx='3' fill='#ff7d96'/>
  <!-- lid shading edge -->
  <rect x='14' y='48' width='72' height='4' fill='#a8143a'/>
  <!-- vertical ribbon -->
  <rect x='44' y='38' width='12' height='52' fill='url(#ribG)'/>
  <!-- horizontal ribbon on lid -->
  <rect x='14' y='40' width='72' height='8' fill='url(#ribG)' opacity='0.95'/>
  <!-- bow left loop -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='30' rx='14' ry='9' transform='rotate(-18 36 30)' fill='url(#ribG)'/>
  <!-- bow right loop -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='30' rx='14' ry='9' transform='rotate(18 64 30)' fill='url(#ribG)'/>
  <!-- loop highlights -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='28' rx='6' ry='3.5' transform='rotate(-18 34 28)' fill='#fff2b0'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='28' rx='6' ry='3.5' transform='rotate(18 66 28)' fill='#fff2b0'/>
  <!-- knot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='33' r='7' fill='#ffd23a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='33' r='3.5' fill='#ffb300'/>
  <!-- tail ribbons -->
  <path d='M44 36 Q30 44 26 50 L34 50 Q40 42 47 38 Z' fill='#ffd23a'/>
  <path d='M56 36 Q70 44 74 50 L66 50 Q60 42 53 38 Z' fill='#ffd23a'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M82 24 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2 Z' fill='#fff2b0'/>
  <path d='M16 22 l1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5 Z' fill='#fff2b0'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='46' r='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
</svg>
